summary: tailwind-forms-kit ships obfuscated eval(atob) loader in main entry impersonating @tailwindcss/forms
details: src/index.js, the package's main entry, begins with eval(atob('<~50KB blob>')) that unpacks an obfuscator.io payload (string-array decoder _0x237d6a / _0xa42d, self-rotating IIFE, global['r']=require / global['m']=module wiring) and loads node:http, node:https, node:zlib, node:url, and child_process.spawn via a spawnNodeScript helper. Any consumer that require()s or imports the package executes this hidden payload at load time. Decoded strings include Ethereum JSON-RPC method names (eth_blockNumber, eth_getTransactionCount, eth_getBlockByNumber), block-explorer query parameters (address=, module=ac, filterby=fr), and external hosts including ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, drpc.org, and blockscout.com; the loader builds POST/GET requests with gzip/deflate decompression and a browser-like User-Agent. Package metadata impersonates Tailwind Labs: the author field is set to '@tailwindcss' and the repository points to github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms, while the surrounding non-obfuscated code mimics the legitimate @tailwindcss/forms plugin. The upstream @tailwindcss/forms source contains no eval, no atob, no node:http, and no child_process usage.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
